status: DRAFT - not approved by Gary, NOT wired into game code
palette: art/world/overworld/palette.hex (64 colours) + full transparency; alpha is 0 or 255 only
scale_rule: draw 1x frames scaled by an integer (2x/3x) with nearest-neighbour only; *_2x files are exact nearest copies
sheet_layout: horizontal strip; frame i rect = [i*w, 0, w, h] (rects[] lists them)
emissive_rule: emissive 'all' -> grade with grades.<g>.lit (lut_<g>_lit.png); 'none' -> grades.<g>.sprite; 'mask' -> per pixel by <name>_emissive_sheet.png. Draw order: palette swaps -> grade.
about: Generic evolution overlay (MECHANICS_PARITY evolution), IP redesign Oct 22 2026: crystal veins grow from the creature's crystal across its body in its Warmth family colours, an ordered-dither front reveals the new form outward from the crystal point, and a ring burst stays inside the sprite area. No silhouette swap, no white flicker, no full-screen flash; every step >= 167 ms. Works for every creature: code masks/recolours the overlay with the existing sprites; nothing is redrawn per creature.

sequence: old sprite normal + text "{old} is changing..."
evo_veins_grow (masked to old sprite, family recolour)
evo_veins_hold loop until the text is dismissed (B cancels -> evo_cancel)
evo_reveal_front: new form revealed outward from the crystal point
evo_ring_burst at the new crystal point
new sprite normal + original jingle + text "{old} became {new}!"

family_recolour.apply_to: every overlay pixel (exact #rrggbb match, authored in the source ramp 3a1e60..f4e2ff)

hooks.mask: veins and the reveal front draw only where the old (or, for the front, old OR new) sprite is opaque; anchor both sprites by their battle bottom-centre anchor

reveal.rule: new pixel shown where dist(p, crystal_point) + (bayer4(p)/16 - 0.5)*12 < REVEAL_R[frame]; else old pixel
reveal.stop_rule: play evo_reveal_front frames until REVEAL_R[frame] >= R_max + 6, then go to evo_ring_burst (R_max = max distance from the crystal point to any opaque pixel of either sprite)
reveal.bayer: 4x4 ordered (fxx_lib.BAYER) keyed to the field (crystal point = field centre)

hooks.cancel: B at any point before evo_reveal_front -> evo_cancel; after the reveal starts it cannot be cancelled
hooks.photosensitivity: Every timed step in every anim is >= 167 ms (<= 6 changes per second). No full-screen flash, no white silhouette, no alternation between the two forms. The burst stays inside the sprite area.
hooks.warmth_cosmic: after the swap the new sprite gets the same Warmth stage and Cosmic flag (apply palette swaps before the ToD grade)
hooks.reduced_motion: evo_reduced_motion replaces grow/hold/reveal/burst; text hooks unchanged
hooks.audio_note: The evolution jingle must be original; Audio checks it by ear.
